newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-General Scanning raised to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-General Scanning raised to neutral.

text.p: -- Madison Securities Inc said Monday it raised its rating on General Scanning Inc to neutral from sell based on the company's improved outlook and better valuation.

-- General Scanning posted higher sales in the first quarter and overall orders are improving, Madison Securities said. Additionally, gross margin expansion and improving expense rations should bolster the company's earnings, Madison Securities said.

-- Madison Securities said it is refraining from recommending buying General Scanning shares for three specific reasons: a relatively soft order flow in some product lines, legal issues that could continue to divert management's attention from more revenue producing activities and a recent jump in the stock price that may recede and offer a better entry price.
-- General Scanning makes laser systems for semiconductor manufacturing as well as printing processing equipment.
-- Its shares were unchanged Monday at 10-1/2.
